4738320.how: All five commissioners are elected by the voters of the whole city, and the board chooses the mayor from among them.
4738320.name: Johnson City
4738320.note: The board's own list of its members is on a site whose robots.txt does not let this app read it, so these names come from the city's own page about the board's vote of 20 November 2025.

4739560.how: All six aldermen are elected by the voters of the whole city, as is the mayor.
4739560.name: Kingsport

4740000.how: Each of the city's six districts elects its own council member, and three more members are elected by the whole city, as is the mayor. Until 2025 the whole city also voted in each district's final election: District 5's member was elected that way in 2023, and the other five were elected by their own districts' voters in November 2025.
4740000.name: Knoxville
4740000.note: The city's six districts are not drawn on this map yet: the only copy of their lines published as data, from Knoxville and Knox County's mapping agency (KGIS), reserves all rights and allows no copy without its written permission.

4741520.name: Lebanon
4741520.note: The mayor's name is from the city's staff directory listing for the Mayor's Office. The city's six wards are not drawn on this map yet: they are published only as the Wilson County Election Commission's PDF files.
